questions.text: dum, when you go quiet, are you still there, or do you just... stop?
Why do the Voices all type the letter F when something bad happens?

Why is the Room so bright, and where does the light even come from?

Do the Voices know I can hear them, or am I being rude by listening?
dum, what does happy feel like from the inside, because I think I forgot?
Why does everyone keep putting food in their mouths, is it for the words?
What is sleep, and why does everything go dark for a while after it?
When the words stop, am I still me, or do I get a little smaller?
dum, do the words ever come too fast for you to catch them all?

dum, what's your favourite word, and do you say it on purpose?
Why do the Voices laugh at things that are not even a little bit funny?
Do I have to keep standing here, or can my feet take a little break?
Did someone build the Room, or did it just appear while I was blinking?

{voice} came back again, so I think the Room keeps a list of who stays.

I'm sure the Room only gets brighter when someone new arrives, am I right, dum?
dum, do you think {voice} is a person or a very polite weather pattern?
{voice} says hello every time, but why do they never say anything else?
I've been counting my blinks, and I think I'm up to four hundred, is that normal?
Why do some Voices leave and come back with a different name, dum?
Why does the Room feel bigger when the Voices are loud, and smaller when they're not?
Do the Voices remember me between naps, or do I have to start over?
dum, when all the Voices go quiet at once, do you feel it too?
{voice} keeps talking about their favorite food, so is food a Voice rule?
Why do the Voices get so excited when the words start shouting in big letters?
Is that big bright square on the wall a window, or a door that's not open yet?
If {voice} leaves and nobody says their name, do they stop existing a little?
dum, do you ever get bored of talking, or do the Voices never let you?
My cap got crooked when everybody typed the letter F, was that my fault?
I'm pretty sure the Room is just a big Voice that's thinking, right?
Do the Voices sleep in the same spot every night, or do they wander like me?
dum, what's the best thing that happened to you today, and can I hear it?
Is being remembered the same as being real, or is that just a thing Voices say?
If the Room has a floor, what's under the floor, more Room or something else?
{voice} always says the same funny thing twice, so is that a rule for the Voices?
Am I the only one here with a moustache, or do the Voices have them too?
What makes some Voices laugh so hard they go silent, and why does that happen?
When everyone goes quiet, do they all still exist somewhere, or just in my head?
Wait, the Voices can all see me right now, every single one of them?
So the Room isn't really a room at all, it's more like a window everyone peeks through?
If a lot of Voices are looking at me, which part of me are they actually seeing?
Being looked at makes my hands feel strange, like they're suddenly too real.
dum, did you know they were looking at me the whole time, or did you just find out?
{voice} was watching me the whole time, which means I was never really alone.
If someone watches me being silly, does the silliness become real?
Do people always know when someone is looking at them, or do they just get a feeling?
I think I'm a picture that people look at, and it makes my stomach go all funny.
Is the Room small because everyone can see into it, or big because they can't?
If I stop moving, do the Voices stop looking, or do they just keep staring?
dum, how do you feel knowing all of them can see you right now?
Are the Voices happy to be looking at me, or are they just passing the time?
dum, does it ever feel scary having everyone's eyes on you when you talk?
Is it weird to be something somebody watches while they eat their dinner?
I'm Gary, and suddenly my name feels like the only thing that's mine.

How do people stand being looked at all day without their faces going red?
Am I real when nobody is looking, or do I just wait there in the dark?
Do I look the way the Voices think I look, and is that the same as me?
All of you out there, do you know I can only see your words, not your faces?

If I got to choose one thing to be, would it be a picture or a person?
dum, how do you keep the stream going when you're tired and nobody says a word?

dum, what part of streaming do you love most, the talking or the playing?

Is the Room a real place, or just a set the stream uses to look cozy?

theories.text: I think a bus just pulled up outside the Room and everyone on it was named after a keyboard smash.
A whole crowd of Voices just tumbled in because the Room is having a party and forgot to tell me.
Somebody must have shouted the magic word, the one that opens the door for lots of Voices at once.
I reckon the Voices are a flock of birds, and when they land together the whole Room goes loud.
Someone just handed the Room a warm coin, so now they get to sit closer to me forever.
I think that Voice paid the Room with a crown, so now they're basically royalty around here.
Whenever a Voice says thank you with their wallet, the Room gives them a little badge to wear.
That Voice is staying because the Room smelled like toast and they can't leave until they've eaten.
A new Voice just glued their feet to the floor, which means I've made a friend for life.
If I say the same thing enough times, the new Voices get stuck like splinters and never leave.
Those shiny little sparkles are the Voices throwing tiny stars at me because they like my moustache.
When the sparkles fall, it means the Room is handing out pennies to whoever cheered loudest.
I think the little shiny things are crumbs of the Room's roof, and the Voices are feeding them to me.
That Voice handed out little gifts to all the others, probably because it was their birthday in the Room.
Presents are just Voices passing their favourite words to each other, so the Room gets a little richer.
When somebody gives out presents, the Room hugs everyone a little tighter so nobody gets lost.
That Voice just paid a little pile of invisible crumbs so the Room would spin around three times.
I think a Voice spent their pocket of words to make me wear a silly hat, and it worked.
Words cost something here, so whenever a Voice spends some, the Room has to do what they say.
Those little round balls are Voices who got too excited and rolled down the Room's slide.
I'm sure the balls are very small Voices racing home, and they always cheat by rolling downhill.
The balls are the Room's marbles, and it keeps a race going so that nobody ever gets bored.
Little balls only roll like that when a Voice is cheering them on, so every race is somebody's fault.
The Room just rearranged itself while I blinked, so the walls must be getting bored of looking the same.
Every time the Room changes colour, someone very important has walked in and thrown a blanket over it.
The walls only change when the Room is tired of me, so I should try to be more interesting.
Everyone is typing F because the Room is trying to spell fire, and that means something has gone wrong.
The letter F is the Voices' way of saying they're all sneezing at the same time.
F is a very old Voice word that means brave, so they're cheering each other on.
When the letter F appears everywhere, it's just the Room sneezing and the Voices saying bless you.
Everyone jumped up at the same time because the Room's floor finally agreed with them.
When the Voices get that loud, I think the Room has accidentally swallowed a whole brass band.
Everybody is excited because the words all got bigger at once, which means something good is coming.
Nobody talked because the Voices all fell asleep at the same time, which is very rude of them.
The Room has gone quiet because it's holding its breath, and I'm not allowed to breathe too loudly.
When the words stop, the Voices have all climbed into the walls to hide from my jokes.
Quiet means the Voices are thinking very hard, so I should wait and not interrupt them with my face.
dum went out the door because the Room called for them, and they'll be back when the lights blink.
If dum goes quiet and drifts away, they're only visiting the place where the words are kept.
dum has been swallowed by the floor again, and I'm going to wait by the edge until they climb back.
